headline: Make committed Daily Rite route choices change the next room's deterministic risk and reward without adding browser token cost.

items.title: Route-choice next-room tuning
items.why: Solara now lets players commit a route posture, but the next room still resolves from the base segment policy. Let survival, tempo, and long-game commitments visibly bend the next clear so the choice becomes a real tactical lever instead of confirmation copy.
items.recipe: Add a pure zero-token commitment adjustment helper and apply it inside Daily Rite room outcome generation when the commitment belongs to the current segment or next wave.

items.title: Visible route-choice outcome contract
items.why: Players need proof that a committed route changed the next room, and Studio surfaces need the same zero-token evidence. Export the applied posture, risk/reward deltas, and next-room bias through the active status contract and public chronicle/status JSON.
items.recipe: Carry `route_choice_adjustment` on room outcomes, render it in the Daily Rite status panel, and include the route-choice digest in generated `status.json`.

items.title: Route-choice tuning contract tests
items.why: The new tuning path consumes player-selected posture data and then influences rewards. Tests need to prove it stays deterministic, bounded, sanitized, and zero-token before deeper shrine-bargain work builds on it.
items.recipe: Extend the Daily Rite test suite to compare survival/tempo/long-game outcomes, validate public-safe adjustment export, and assert generated chronicle/status route-choice surfaces remain zero-token.

executionLog.evidence: Added bounded zero-token route_choice_adjustment tuning inside src/game/dailyRiteRoomOutcome.js so committed survival, tempo, and long-game postures alter next-room risk, reward, recovery, and receipt copy deterministically.

Daily Rite status contracts and the active status panel now expose the applied route-choice adjustment; generated public/status.json now includes daily_rite_route_choices alongside public chronicle exports.
npm test passes 63/63, including deterministic next-room tuning, sanitizer, zero-token, and public chronicle/status route-choice export assertions.
